title: How the prior day's S&P 500 returns influence the intraday returns of Nikkei 225 futures
summary: Foreign payoff target and unresolved causal filtering; no owned-input test.
about: US prior-session information and Nikkei futures returns.
findings: Authors' indexed strategy claims apply to Nikkei futures; ES is a predictor. Same-year median-volume classification also needs an availability audit.
mechanism: Cross-market delayed information transmission is proposed; not an ES target strategy.
build_on: No current TEST: owned ES is not the payoff instrument and full causal filtering is unverified.
can_strategy_code_be_made: Requires native Nikkei inputs and source clocks; trading ES instead would change the hypothesis.
source_version: 2026 publisher article, source history2001–24; full revision unread.
owned_input_mapping: Nikkei futures history/session clocks, not supplied by owned ES.
deeper_investigation: Do not spend trials on a predictor/target substitution.
